Complete pair decisions for these nine have not run yet, so this is preparation, not confirmed feasibility or publication. The bounded replay tool is being independently checked before execution.

The reported import’s full gate and hosted CI are in progress, including a failed hosted sweep under investigation. The earlier eighteen-count request #401 is complete: both import/confirmation stacks merged, matching deployment and full live checks passed, and the accurate [final reply](https://github.com/jlevy/squares/issues/401#issuecomment-6048513671) was posted before closure. This issue remains separate and open.
